dogecoin.text:
At launch, you can bridge:

→ $USDT: 0xB6dc6C8b71e88642cEAD3be1025565A9eE74d1C6
→ $USDC: 0x97eec1c29f745dC7c267F90292AA663d997a601D
→ $wETH: 0xFF13A7A12fd485BC9687fF88D8Ae1A6b655Ab469

And you’ll be using $DOGE as gas to power every transaction!

Dogechain is a blockchain built to extend the utility of Dogecoin, allowing users to access DeFi, NFTs, and dApps while using DOGE as gas. 

So the answer is simple: Dogechain is where memes meet real utility!
